t: What Supplier Capability Database Is All About
title: What Supplier Capability Database Is All About
description: Supplier capability is what a supplier can actually do: processes certified (ISO 9001, AS9100, IATF 16949), capacity available, quality history (PPM defect rates), and financial health.
